records.title: Bonsai: Efficient and Optimal Automatic Tensor Rematerialization for Memory-Constrained DNN Training
records.reason: Automatic tensor rematerialization targets DNN training memory/efficiency; training-only.

records.title: The Developer as Curator: A Canvas for Coding Agent Context
records.reason: Coding-agent context canvas is an interaction/context curation interface, not a measured inference-efficiency method.

records.title: How to express social presence: a comparison of perceptions of social robots’ cognitive abilities
records.reason: Study of social robots’ perceived cognitive abilities, unrelated to LLM inference/serving.

records.title: Budget Boundary Effects in Test-Time Mathematical Reasoning
records.reason: Useful evidence about test-time budget accounting and policy boundary effects, but the paper is an observational controller/replay analysis rather than a demonstrated inference-efficiency optimization; its own results reject strong equal-compute or equivalence claims. Keep borderline for scope/claim strength.

records.title: Self-Evolving Algorithm-Design Agents: Escaping In-Context Evolutionary Stagnation via Population-Curated Policy Optimization
records.reason: There is a quantified inference-token outcome, but the mechanism is domain-specific policy training and the evidence is total tokens over a fixed 16-rollout algorithm-design process, not general inference/serving optimization or latency/energy. Retain as borderline unless downstream scope accepts training-based domain adaptation as inference-efficiency work.
